headline: Going Commando reports 97.38% matched code for USA v1.01
summary: Going Commando's refreshed progress report raises USA v1.01 from 96.18% to 97.38% matched code, with 8,452 of 8,527 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The other releases have their own figures: PAL reaches 95.57% of code and 8,483 of 8,607 functions, while USA v2.00 reaches 96.17% and 8,468 of 8,579 functions. Compiler corrections unlocked matches for the main level loop, sound-system startup and PAL's tile-board update.
highlights: Further USA v1.01 matches landed after the last progress refresh, so the reported figures do not include that later work.
OpenRAC's local fixes are upstream, including sound-slot bounds and setting effect colours before their first draw (#435).
#433 and #436 document near misses rather than adding matches. The strand routine documented in #434 was subsequently matched in a later commit.
A later correction restored #433, #434 and #435 after rewritten commits accidentally reverted their changes.
